metadata.abstract: In this note we prove an explicit binomial formula for Jack poly nomials and discuss some applications of it. 1. Jack polynomials ( [M,St]). In this note we use the parameter θ = 1/α inverse to the standard parameter α for Jack polynomials. Jack symmetric poly- nomials Pλ (x1,...,x n;θ) are eigenfunctions of Sekiguchi diﬀerential operators D(u;θ) = V (x)−1 det [ xn−j i ( xi ∂ ∂x i + (n −j)θ +u )] 1≤i,j ≤n , D(u;θ)Pλ (x;θ) = ( ∏ i (λ i + (n −i)θ +u) ) Pλ (x;θ),(1.1) where V (x) =∏ i<j(xi −xj) is the Vandermonde determinant and u is a parame- ter. The operators {D(u;θ),u ∈ C} generate a commutative algebra; denote it by D(n;θ). We normalize Pλ (x1,...,x n;θ) so that Pλ (x1,...,x n;θ) = xλ 1 1 ...x λ n n +... , where dots stand for lower monomials in lexicographic order . Then one has (1.2) P(λ 1+1,...,λ n+1)(x;θ) = ( ∏ xi ) Pλ (x;θ). Using (1.2) one can deﬁne Jack rational functions for any int egers λ 1 ≥ · · · ≥ λ n and still (1.1), and hence the binomial theorem below, will h old.
